opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Immigration Legal Services
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration is renewing a contract to provide FJC Immigration Legal Services to its clientele, using a renewal award procurement vehicle. The service will be delivered under the existing contract terms for FY27.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Immigration Legal Center
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services and the Mayor’s Office to End Domestic and Gender‑Based Violence are renewing a contract to deliver core civil immigration‑related legal services—including status applications, agency and court representation, legal screening, advice, and support for self‑represented clients—at the five New York City Family Justice Centers for survivors of domestic and gender‑based violence.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Family Law Legal Services
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services' Office of Civil Justice and the Mayor’s Office to End Domestic and Gender‑Based Violence are renewing a contract to provide core civil family‑law services at the city’s five Family Justice Centers. The services include legal screening, advice, self‑representation support, and court representation for survivors of domestic and gender‑based violence on matters such as divorce, custody, visitation, and support. This FY27 renewal is a direct award renewal for the family‑law legal services program.

opportunities.title: The Arches program, which targets high-crime neighborhoods. Procurement is for human client services, as such Competitive Sealed Proposals is the most appropriate source selection method. E jy17 ARCHE
opportunities.summary: The agency is procuring human client services for the Arches program in high‑crime neighborhoods (awarded to Youth Justice Network) and permanent supportive congregate housing and related services for HIV/AIDS clients with mental health or substance‑use needs (awarded to Harlem United Community AIDS Center), as well as Family Justice Center immigration legal services (awarded to Sanctuary for). All contracts are being awarded under Competitive Sealed Proposals.

opportunities.title: In-Person/VRI interpretation for Spoken Languages Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children's Services (ACS) is awarding three contracts for in-person and video remote interpretation for spoken languages, deaf/hard-of-hearing interpretation, language services, and written translation. The services will support ACS and its network of providers in serving limited‑English proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families, and the contracts will run from July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2029. The procurement will be awarded via a competitive sealed proposal process.

opportunities.title: Deaf/Hard-of-Hearing Language Access Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services is awarding a competitive sealed‑proposal contract to provide sign‑language interpretation—including in‑person, on‑site and on‑demand video remote services for ASL, Certified Deaf Interpretation, foreign sign languages and CART—from July 1 2026 through June 30 2029. The services will support ACS and its network of providers in meeting legal accessibility obligations for limited‑English‑proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families.

opportunities.title: Translation Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services is awarding three contracts for in‑person and video‑remote interpretation, deaf/hard‑of‑hearing interpretation, language services, and written translation. The services are for ACS and its network of providers to serve limited‑English‑proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families. The contracts will be awarded via competitive sealed proposals for a term from July 1 2026 through June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - NYCitizenship Program
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration is renewing a contract to provide legal screenings and free legal assistance to participants in the NYCitizenship Program, guiding them through the naturalization process. The services aim to help clients become eligible for greater SSI benefits and reduce reliance on DSS benefits.
